# pve_storage_import_metadata (Data Source)

Import metadata for a volume (how to import it as a guest).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_import_metadata" "example" {
  node    = "pve1"
  storage = "local"
  volume  = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.
- `volume` (String) Volume identifier for the guest archive/entry.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<storage>.
- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Read-Only:

- `create_args` (Attributes) Parameters which can be used in a call to create a VM or container. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--create_args))
- `disks` (Attributes) Recognised disk volumes as `$bus$id` => `$storeid:$path` map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--disks))
- `net` (Attributes) Recognised network interfaces as `net$id` => { ...params } object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--net))
- `source` (String) The type of the import-source of this guest volume.
- `type` (String) The type of guest this is going to produce.
- `warnings` (Attributes List) List of known issues that can affect the import of a guest. Note that lack of warning does not imply that there cannot be any problems. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--warnings))
